findings.title: Enforce the declared8KiB console limit on the settled failure path
findings.observation: console_failure truncates diagnostic output on initial/finalizer refusal paths, but successful finalization reaches the unchanged final print(json.dumps(result)). A retained failure result may approach the16KiB result_file cap, exceeding the policy8KiB per-console-record claim. With primary/secondary diagnostics it is also not structurally bounded by console_failure.

Version a narrow successor that uses bounded console_failure for finalized non-complete status (full result remains retained in mixed-result.json), enforces an8KiB encoded limit on every console record, and adds a worst-case successfully-finalized failure regression. Preserve exact science/runtime/source/caps and root20kentry/finalreserve accounting.
